decisions.reason: This two-component resin injection unit remains close to the firm's established plural-component and injection knowledge, so accumulated learning and existing engineering capabilities favor continued refinement rather than withdrawal.

Because Product B also builds directly on the firm's core fluid-handling and two-component application competences, management is likely to keep it while using market experience and internal know-how to improve its commercial fit.

A manual airless spray gun sits squarely within the firm's long-standing spray technology base, making it a product the firm can readily support, interpret customer feedback on, and sustain through incremental development.
